environmentDiagnosis: read-heavy-08: Explain why the local API starts before its database is usable

composeFaults.statement: Short depends_on syntax waits for container start, not the database healthcheck.
The API listens/exposes 8080 while its healthcheck probes localhost:3000.

irrelevantSignals: The pinned Postgres 16.4 image is not evidence of this readiness race.
